**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is planning a trip to Japan.
- [FACT] User will be staying in Shibuya for 7 nights.
- [FACT] User booked an Airbnb in Shibuya.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for good restaurants in Shibuya.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Shibuya has plenty of delicious food options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended breakfast spots: 
  1. Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi (5-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Fresh sushi for breakfast, omakase course recommended.
  2. Komeda's Coffee (multiple locations in Shibuya) - Popular Japanese coffee chain, coffee and sandwiches or toast recommended.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended lunch spots:
  1. Ichiran Shibuya (5-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Famous tonkotsu ramen chain, solo dining experience.
  2. Nonbei Yokocho (5-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Small alleyway with food stalls, Toriyoshi for yakitori recommended.
  3. Shibuya's Ichiran (10-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Another popular ramen spot.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended dinner spots:
  1. Ginza Kyubey (10-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - High-end sushi restaurant, omakase course recommended.
  2. Yakiniku Jumbo Han no Daidokoro Bettei (10-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - High-end yakiniku restaurant with premium meats.
  3. Tofuya Ukai (15-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Tofu restaurant with various dishes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended snacks and desserts:
  1. Harajuku Cream Puff Cafe (10-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Freshly baked cream puffs.
  2. Kawaii Monster Cafe (10-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Colorful cafe with unique desserts.
  3. Shibuya's Fresh Fruit Parlor (5-minute walk from Shibuya Station) - Fresh fruit smoothies and parfaits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other recommendations include Shibuya's Food Court (inside Shibuya Station) and Nonbei Yokocho's Street Food (5-minute walk from Shibuya Station).
- [USER] User expressed interest in trying the recommended restaurants.
